about: A note’s classification as its front matter gives it: none, given (with its level) or unknown when it cannot be read for certain. Shared by the core’s gate (packages/core/test/claude-gate-classification.test.js, classificationOf in claude-gate.ts) and the Python library (python/graph_spec/tests/test_classification.py, classification_of), so the two never give one note different classes (TRUST-9).

cases.name: a plain value is given
a quoted value is given without quotes
a value with a comment after it
no front matter is none, whatever the body says
a classification line in the body after front matter does not count
cases.text:
---
title: x
---
Some text.
classification: Restricted

cases.name: front matter that never ends is none
a nested key does not count
a key inside a block scalar does not count
cases.text:
---
about: |
  classification: Restricted
classification: Public
---
Some text.

a list item is not a key
two keys are unknown

classification: Restricted
